description: Compose hearing protection with the canonical Loud Room and Dam refill event, make a real field stone keep the evolved House trap door physically open, and recognize loaded-sack chimney bundling

replacements.new:
<GLOBAL LOUD-FLAG <>>

<ROUTINE PLAYER-INGENUITY-LOUD-ECHO-SOLVE ()
	 <SETG LOUD-FLAG T>
	 <FCLEAR ,BAR ,SACREDBIT>
	 <TELL "The acoustics of the room change subtly." CR>
	 <COND (<NOT ,SUPER-BRIEF> <CRLF>)>
	 <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE LOUD-ROOM-FCN

replacements.old:
(T
		       <TELL " The room is deafeningly loud with an
undetermined rushing sound. The sound seems to reverberate from all
of the walls, making it difficult even to think.">)>

		       <COND (<PLAYER-INGENUITY-EARMUFFS-WORN?>
		              <TELL " The room is violently loud, but the padded cups turn the worst of the roar into heavy pressure and distant thunder. You can still think.">)
		             (T
		              <TELL " The room is deafeningly loud with an
undetermined rushing sound. The sound seems to reverberate from all
of the walls, making it difficult even to think.">)>)>

		      (T

replacements.old:
<ROUTINE UP-CHIMNEY-FUNCTION ("AUX" F)
  <COND (<NOT <SET F <FIRST? ,WINNER>>>
	 <TELL "Going up empty-handed is a bad idea." CR>
	 <RFALSE>)
	(<AND <OR <NOT <SET F <NEXT? .F>>>
		  <NOT <NEXT? .F>>>
	      <IN? ,LAMP ,WINNER>>
	 <COND (<NOT <FSET? ,TRAP-DOOR ,OPENBIT>>
		<FCLEAR ,TRAP-DOOR ,TOUCHBIT>)>
	 <RETURN ,KITCHEN>)
	(T
	 <TELL "You can't get up there with what you're carrying." CR>
	 <RFALSE>)>>
replacements.new:
<ROUTINE UP-CHIMNEY-FUNCTION ("AUX" F)
  <COND (<NOT <SET F <FIRST? ,WINNER>>>
	 <TELL "Going up empty-handed is a bad idea." CR>
	 <RFALSE>)
	(<AND <OR <NOT <SET F <NEXT? .F>>>
		  <NOT <NEXT? .F>>>
	      <IN? ,LAMP ,WINNER>>
	 <COND (<NOT <FSET? ,TRAP-DOOR ,OPENBIT>>
		<FCLEAR ,TRAP-DOOR ,TOUCHBIT>)>
	 <COND (<PLAYER-INGENUITY-SACK-BUNDLED?>
	        <TELL "Bundling the smaller gear inside the brown sack keeps the chimney problem to two manageable packages. The container earns its keep all the way up." CR>)>
	 <RETURN ,KITCHEN>)
	(T
	 <TELL "You can't get up there with what you're carrying." CR>
	 <RFALSE>)>>
